title: Week 4 risers and fallers in the MFPI
dek: The largest statewide rank moves this week, with the verified results and rating changes behind each one.
author: MFPI automated analysis

sources.label: MHSAA official score center (schedules and scores)
Statewide media rankings used for the Media Rank inputs

limitations: Movement is only shown against a comparable previous snapshot; teams without one are NEW.
Large moves in the middle of the table often reflect tightly bunched ratings rather than dramatic results.

sections.heading: How to read these moves
paragraphs: Rank movement is last week's statewide rank minus this week's. Rating change is this week's displayed MFPI minus last week's. They are separate facts: in the middle of the table, where ratings are close together, a small rating change can move a team many places, and a team can hold its place while its rating changes.
Both compare the Week 4 snapshot with the latest audited Week 3 snapshot (formula MFPI-3.2).

sections.heading: Data notes and limitations
paragraphs: Snapshot generated September 22, 2026 at 11:19 AM Central with a cutoff of September 22 at 11:00 AM Central, formula MFPI-3.2.
458 of 465 game listings due by the cutoff had verified scores (98.5%); the rest count as unavailable, never as losses or 0-0 results.

[[cleveland-central]] had no linked results in this snapshot because the score feed lists the school under a different name. The link has been confirmed and applies from the next weekly run; until then its rating is provisional and does not reflect its games.

No verified results were linked to [[northside]] for this cutoff. Their ratings are provisional and rest on class, media and neutral inputs; their positions should not be read as the product of games.

[[houston]] is credited with two games on Sep 11 in this snapshot. One of them was played by a same-named out-of-state school; that game is removed from [[houston]]'s record from the next weekly run, which also affects its opponents.
Opponent ranks in this article are the opponent's rank in this snapshot, not its rank on the day the game was played, unless a sentence says otherwise.
